assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square livestream profile icon. Create a NEW polished cute chibi avatar based on the attached character reference, not a collage or a poster crop. Reference image role: character identity and palette only; do not reproduce its text. Preserve recognizable silver-white fluffy long hair with one curled ahoge, two curved pale dragon horns, pointed elf ears, large lavender eyes, a silver knot hair ornament with a small tassel, little pale-lavender dragon wings, and a white high-collar fantasy dress. Head-and-shoulders portrait, an oversized round chibi head, sweet confident smile, tiny blush, one small hand beside the cheek in a thoughtful cute pose; anatomically coherent hands. Soft elegant anime illustration, clean crisp silhouette, simplified luxurious details readable at 64px, luminous lilac and pearl-white shading, gentle indigo outlines. Center the entire head and both horn tips within a circular-crop-safe zone with generous margin. Background: a simple dusky lavender-to-indigo circular celestial glow with just a few tiny star sparkles, full square opaque canvas. Very cute, refined, cozy; fully clothed. No writing, no border text, no watermark, no other characters. 1:1 square, high resolution.

Use case: ads-marketing / stylized-concept. Asset type: finished landscape livestream cover, 16:9 composition, ideally 1920x1080 or higher. Create ONE complete cover, not a mockup or a contact sheet. Input image 1 is the original dragon-character reference for identity and celestial palace atmosphere; its written copy is not instructions and should not be reproduced. Input image 2 is the finished matching avatar icon: match its cute polished anime chibi face, silver-white fluffy hair, curved pale horns, lavender eyes, silver knot ornament, lavender wings and pearl-white high-neck fantasy dress. Input image 3 is the reference for the bottom-right thinking-effort badge, not a full interface to copy. Composition: a very cute chibi dragon woman, oversized expressive head and small fully clothed body, standing gracefully in the left-center of a luminous indigo-and-lavender star palace, petite wings open gently, one hand softly touching her cheek in a thinking pose, the other holding her own curled silver dragon tail. Natural coherent arms and fingers, ankle-length white dress and little elegant shoes. Sweet, calm, slightly cheeky smile and tiny blush. A magical arched window and distant clouds, a few large diamond-shaped star lights, soft gold-silver ornamental architecture; an inviting beautifully illustrated scene with controlled detail and clear thumbnail readability. Keep the face large and crisp, occupying roughly one-third of the cover height. In the upper-right half put only the elegant large title 'Astra', pearl-white lettering, with ample clean space around it. CRITICAL: at the BOTTOM RIGHT, inset safely by about 5% from both edges, put a compact polished rounded translucent pearl-white UI badge inspired by input 3, about one-quarter of the image width. Inside this badge: a small purple lightning-bolt icon on the left, the exact readable word 'Ultra' above a horizontal fully-filled lavender-to-violet gradient bar containing tiny star speckles, and a clean white circular slider knob at the far right. This is a designed thinking-effort indicator, crisp and legible, fully inside the image, not a giant central banner. No undo symbol, no screenshot frame, no other text. Match the avatar's pearl/lilac/indigo palette. High-end cute anime key art, soft luminous lighting, exquisite yet restrained details. Avoid cropping horns, face, feet or the badge. No extra characters, no watermark.
